findings.summary: Connector error state uses hardcoded Tailwind palette (bg-red-500/10 text-red-700) and repeated text-red-700 for lastError instead of the design tokens --danger/--danger-soft used everywhere else in the app.
findings.fix: Replace bg-red-500/10 text-red-700 with bg-[var(--danger-soft)] text-[var(--danger)] and text-red-700 with text-[var(--danger)] so the state adapts to dark theme and matches AppErrorBoundary/status tokens.

findings.summary: Log rows hardcode bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 and bg-red-500/10 text-red-700 for status icons instead of --success/--success-soft and --danger/--danger-soft tokens, so success/failure colors won't respond to dark mode.
findings.fix: Use bg-[var(--success-soft)] text-[var(--success)] for success and bg-[var(--danger-soft)] text-[var(--danger)] for failed; use text-[var(--danger)] for the error paragraph.

findings.summary: Automation run error banner uses bg-red-500/10 text-red-700 instead of danger tokens, breaking token consistency and dark-theme contrast.
findings.fix: Change the error paragraph to className with bg-[var(--danger-soft)] p-3 ... text-[var(--danger)].

findings.summary: Outbox table/mobile error cells hardcode text-red-700 (lines 67 and 68) rather than the --danger token.
findings.fix: Replace both text-red-700 occurrences with text-[var(--danger)].

findings.summary: The load-failure state is rendered via EmptyState, but the app pattern for query errors is a dedicated error banner (AppErrorBoundary uses a danger-tinted surface); EmptyState reads as a benign no-data message for an actual failure.
findings.fix: Render an error banner styled with bg-[var(--danger-soft)]/border and an AlertTriangle in --danger (matching AppErrorBoundary), or at minimum pass a retry action so the failure is visually distinct from empty results.

findings.summary: Search is a bespoke input inside a .filter-bar rather than the shared FilterBar primitive, and there is no result count for the active tab, unlike the app's standard filter UX (FilterBar exposes resultText/isDirty/onClear).
findings.fix: Either adopt FilterBar (passing searchValue/onSearchChange/searchPlaceholder + a resultText like `عرض ${connectors.length} من ${total}` and isDirty/onClear when search is non-empty), or add a filter-result count line and a clear (X) affordance to the current bar.

findings.summary: The enable/disable connector checkbox has no accessible name tied to which connector it controls; screen readers only hear the generic 'الموصل مفعّل/متوقف' text without the connector name.
findings.fix: Add aria-label={`تفعيل الموصل ${item.name}`} to the checkbox input so its purpose is unambiguous.

findings.summary: The loading skeleton is a single bespoke h-72 pulsing card, which does not match the tab layout it replaces (metric cards + grid/table) and differs from other pages' skeleton density.
findings.fix: Render skeletons that mirror the connectors grid (e.g. a grid of card-sized animate-pulse placeholders) so the loading state matches the resolved layout and shared skeleton pattern.
